svg.title: Lamport's mutex over FIFO channels: B waits its turn
svg.desc: Timelines for A, B. request on A: L 1; queue (1,A); heard B:0; holds no. request on B: L 1; queue (1,B); heard A:0; holds no. req from B on A, receiving req 1 from request on B: L 3; queue (1,A) (1,B); heard B:1; holds yes. req from A on B, receiving req 1 from request on A: L 3; queue (1,A) (1,B); heard A:1; holds no. ack from A on B, receiving ack 3 from req from B on A: L 4; queue (1,A) (1,B); heard A:3; holds no. ack from B on A, receiving ack 3 from req from A on B: L 4; queue (1,A) (1,B); heard B:3; holds yes. release on A: L 5; queue (1,B); heard B:3; holds no. release from A on B, receiving release 5 from release on A: L 6; queue (1,B); heard A:5; holds yes. Note 1: A's request (1,A) reaches B before anything A sent after it, and goes ahead of B's own (1,B) in B's queue. Note 2: B has heard from A at 3, later than its request, but A's request is first in its queue, so B waits. Note 3: A releases: B drops (1,A) from its queue, its own request is first, and B enters.

g.text: 1. A's request (1,A) reaches B before anything A sent after it, and goes ahead of B's own (1,B) in B's
2. B has heard from A at 3, later than its request, but A's request is first in its queue, so B waits
3. A releases: B drops (1,A) from its queue, its own request is first, and B enters
